Add --write-config-to flag to kubelet. Kubelet configuration with flags is deprecated and users are told to use a configuration file instead. However, there is no straightforward

issue_context.title: Add --write-config-to option to kubelet
issue_context.body:
### What would you like to be added?

Add a new `--write-config-to` flag to kubelet, similar to [kube-scheduler](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/62515) and [kube-proxy](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/45908).

This flag can be used to render the kubelet configuration file from a set of command-line arguments. For example:

```bash
kubelet [--arg1 --arg2 --arg3] --write-config-to kubelet.conf
kubelet --config kubelet.conf
```

### Why is this needed?

In existing Kubernetes clusters we get lots of warnings like:

```
Flag --feature-gates has been deprecated, This parameter should be set via the config file specified by the Kubelet's --config flag. See https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/kubelet-config-file/ for more information.
Flag --eviction-hard has been deprecated, This parameter should be set via the config file specified by the Kubelet's --config flag. See https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/kubelet-config-file/ for more information.
```

But there is no easy way to generate a config file for existing clusters.
